about: Learn's clips (Part 47 / 47b): each a G-code file with (Video ...) lines - the page plays it live (js/page/help.js), tools/record_demo.js records a demo for YouTube. Its title, group, kind (demo | mine) and one line come from its own (Video Learn: ...) header (js/demo_script.js learnOf); this list is just the files, in their order in Learn, with secs = about how long a demo plays live (measured; without it the page works it out from the script).
